interpretation_safeguards: successful compilation proves acceptance by the recorded Lean environment, not source faithfulness
a later declaration depending on an earlier declaration proves formal reuse and compositional typechecking, not either statement's faithfulness to Higham
error propagation through dependencies is evidence of integration, not a source-faithfulness audit
an import edge is not necessarily a logical theorem dependency
an import without a logical edge can still be required for elaboration, notation, tactics, attributes, macros, or instances
no incoming project edge does not imply redundancy or lack of external API purpose
generated declarations are not handwritten public API
direct and transitive dependencies must not be conflated
exact-statement equality does not prove semantic or API redundancy
high fan-in is internal-consumption evidence, not automatically interface quality
a successful temporary client proves usability only for that probe
direct public-type exposure signals are review strata, not proof of an API defect or an aggregate API-quality score
entry-module reachability is module-ownership exposure, not practical usability
the reused-low-in-hierarchy product is a per-declaration ranking heuristic, not a cohesion score and not an aggregable library metric
confirmed-source-written induced weak-component coverage is connectedness, not directional reuse; excluded generated or unresolved intermediates can affect induced singleton status
